# Scarf

> Out-of-core, provenance-backed single-cell analysis for RNA, ATAC, protein, and matched multi-omic data. Follow the linked documentation for the installed release. Do not infer unsupported methods or biological conclusions.

## Get started

- [Home](index.html): scope, measured scale, implemented methods, validation, and current boundaries
- [Installation](installation.html): supported Python versions and installation paths
- [Quick start](quickstart.html): open a prepared PBMC run and inspect its selected clusters
- [Coming from Scanpy or Seurat](scanpy_and_seurat.html): shared mental model and route to the focused migration guides
- [Scanpy users](scanpy.html): workflow mapping and H5AD exchange
- [Seurat users](seurat.html): workflow mapping, RDS import, and WNN differences

## Core workflows

- [scRNA-seq heterogeneity](tutorials/scrna_seq.html): interpret a prepared PBMC run with marker evidence
- [scATAC-seq](tutorials/scatac_seq.html): peak filtering, LSI, graph construction, clustering, and gene scores
- [CITE-seq](tutorials/cite_seq.html): matched RNA and ADT analysis with WNN integration

## Biological recipes

- [Cell type annotation](tutorials/annotation.html): marker interpretation and label assignment
- [Cell cycle](tutorials/cell_cycle.html): canonical phase scoring
- [Gene-set scoring](tutorials/gene_set_scoring.html): AUCell and WAGGR activity scores
- [Pseudobulk and differential expression](tutorials/pseudobulk_and_differential_expression.html): biological-replicate aggregation and export
- [Condition comparisons](tutorials/condition_comparisons.html): matched donor-level testing and its limits
- [Pseudotime](tutorials/pseudotime.html): supervised sources and sinks
- [Expression dynamics](tutorials/expression_dynamics.html): feature profiles and modules
- [Fate mapping](tutorials/fate_mapping.html): multiple terminal outcomes
- [Trajectory validation](tutorials/trajectory_validation.html): boundary, graph, statistical, and numerical checks
- [Imputation](tutorials/imputation.html): graph diffusion for exploratory visualization

## Integration and mapping

- [Dataset merging](tutorials/dataset_merging.html): compatible stores and an uncorrected joint baseline
- [Batch correction](tutorials/batch_correction.html): Harmony, batch mixing, and biological conservation
- [Mapping and label transfer](tutorials/mapping_and_label_transfer.html): fixed-reference projection

## Diagnostics and method choices

- [Quality control](tutorials/quality_control.html): modality-aware and sample-aware filtering
- [Feature selection](tutorials/feature_selection.html): feature-set diagnostics
- [Graph construction](tutorials/graph_construction.html): granular normalization, reduction, neighbours, and graphs
- [Dimensionality reduction](tutorials/dimensionality_reduction.html): PCA dimensions and layout comparison
- [Clustering](tutorials/clustering.html): Leiden, Paris, stability, connectivity, and markers
- [Multimodal diagnostics](tutorials/multimodal_diagnostics.html): compare SNN and WNN and inspect modality weights

## Data, remote, and scale

- [Memory and execution](concepts/memory_and_execution.html): resource budgets, concurrency, and I/O
- [Benchmarks](concepts/benchmarks.html): measured end-to-end timings, peak memory, and limitations
